result: Explicit undistorted lamp copies of Z^d exclude locally finite asymptotic dimension for the two-generated group. Finite-dimensional generic-action results do not directly settle the target.

An equivariant Borel integer height reduces the orbit relation to the abelian lamp relation, with explicit bounded-height finite exhaustions. Such a global height is unavailable for compact actions with invariant probability, so this alone does not prove generic hyperfiniteness.

route: Compatible profinite heights and finite-width slabs
result: A countable dense-open lifting argument yields a profinite-height factor generically. Factorial slab graphs increase, have finite Borel asymptotic dimension, and exhaust all generator edges away from the integer-height preimage. CJMST's compatible-union theorem plus the approach-2 exceptional-set exhaustion proves the full target, pending independent review.
